verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Cline-provided sandbox environment that isolates execution from production data. Plan mode is a read-only, dry-run-style mode, not a sandbox. Kanban's isolated git worktrees and checkpoints/undo isolate or revert code changes, but they do not provide a separate test environment for commands or data. These are adjacent features and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
